rows.headline: Money deducted during failed UPI transactions? Here is how to claim your refund and register complaints.
rows.hook: Know your rights when UPI fails
rows.summary: Many UPI users face instances where money is debited from their bank account but the transaction fails at the merchant end. According to NPCI guidelines, failed transactions should be reversed automatically within T+1 or T+4 days depending on the type of transfer. If banks fail to process the refund within the stipulated timeline, customers are entitled to daily compensation. Retail investors and everyday users should understand these grievance redressal mechanisms to protect their digital payments.
rows.why_it_matters: Claim daily compensation if your failed UPI refund is delayed.
